structured_output.what_is_happening: A "Kardashev Research" meta is running on Solana. It seems to come from a post by @beffjezos (Beff/e/acc) linked in GeckoTerminal as status 2103746282699534606. I couldn't read the post because X returned HTTP 402. At least 10 same-name KARDASHEV tokens were launched within about 2.5 hours. This one is a Meteora clone created at 09:25Z, about an hour after the leading copy (5wW9…, $2.0M market cap). It rose about 510% to roughly $70k in 16 minutes. The flow is lopsided: 2,059 unique buyers against only 59 unique sellers, with 37 bundler wallets and a top-bundler trader share of 63%. The LP is 100% unlocked, and there is no website, socials or DexScreener profile.

narrative.description: A cluster of 'Kardashev Research' tokens tied to Beff Jezos (e/acc founder, whose profile says 'Kardashev scaling is all you need'). The post seems to announce or mention something called Kardashev Research.
narrative.why_spreading: A high-profile e/acc/AI-accelerationist figure posted about it, and the name is catchy. Many rival deployers are copying it, which shows real demand for the narrative, but that demand is split across clones.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond sharing the name. It is a late Meteora copy with no profile or socials. Its only link is the Beff tweet URL set in its GeckoTerminal metadata, which any clone can copy.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9mhbw… ($2.0M market cap, $146k liquidity, earliest large copy, most likely the leader); 8Rz6… ($968k); Gff9… ($8.7M hourly volume); 6MuH… ($474k); HrQz…; AAye… (liquidity already pulled to $90, a rug precedent in this same cluster); and several dead pump.fun copies.

authenticity.evidence: 2,059 unique buyers against 59 unique sellers, with 37 bundler wallets holding a 63% top-bundler trader share and a 66.5% bot/degen rate. One clone in the cluster (AAye…) already has $90 of liquidity left, a pulled-LP pattern. The creator status is 'creator_close'.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 45.66% top holder may be the Meteora pool account that RugCheck didn't label, so real concentration could be lower. I couldn't see any X posts.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on Meteora, so the owner can pull it at any time
Many same-name clones, with the leader at 28x this market cap
A sibling clone has already had its liquidity pulled

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is live and strong enough to push several clones to $1–9M market cap. Rotation traders hunting cheaper copies could push a $70k clone to 2x quickly, and 2,000+ buyers in 16 minutes shows real flow. If the 45.66% holder is just the pool, the structure is less bad than it looks.
